_about: Every threshold in one place. Read by the Python pipeline (explorer/settings.py) and the front-end prototype (frontend/src/lib/settings.ts). Change a value here only, and log the change in the Change Log.
limitationLine: Unusual activity requires investigation; it does not indicate wrongdoing.

collection._failoverHoldSeconds: after repeated HTTP 429s from one host, use the other for this long (plan §6.2: switch to mempool.space for an hour)

corpus._sources: keys of settings.source to crawl from; Blockstream allows only 700 unauthenticated requests per hour per IP, far too few for DS2
corpus._targetAddresses: 4,000 (user, 23 Oct): above the plan's 3,000 minimum; at ~1.6 kept/min it is reached before pretraining ends, so the GPU never waits for DS2
corpus._workersPerSource: replies take a median 4.3 s (mempool.space throttles large pages), so 4 workers reached ~1 request/s; 8 stay under the 2 request starts/s that requestPauseSeconds allows

bitcoinheist.name: BitcoinHeist Ransomware Address Dataset (UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 526)
bitcoinheist.citation: Akcora, C.G., Li, Y., Gel, Y.R. and Kantarcioglu, M. (2020) BitcoinHeist: topological data analysis for ransomware prediction on the Bitcoin blockchain. IJCAI-PRICAI 2020.

elliptic.name: Elliptic Data Set (Kaggle)
elliptic.citation: Weber, M. et al. (2019) Anti-money laundering in Bitcoin: experimenting with graph convolutional networks for financial forensics. KDD '19 Workshop on Anomaly Detection in Finance.
elliptic._licence: No derivatives: processed Elliptic rows are never committed or zipped; the repository ships only the download record, code, metrics and figures (plan §6.3).

features._sizeComparisonOptions: same-direction (proposed CR-04: size features compared only with earlier transactions in the same direction) or all (report §2.3 as written)
features._zClip: own-history z-scores are clipped to +/- this before pooled models (plan §6.2), so one extreme value cannot dominate

featuresAsWritten._about: The method exactly as A1 §2.3 wrote it, for the refinement ablation (plan §6.2): a plain 30-day window with no extension (CR-02), all directions (CR-04), no log transform of F3/F4 and no floor on the spread (CR-05). Every other value comes from features and baseline.

regression._validationFraction: the last share of each address's fit period used for tuning, time order kept
regression._residualFloor: minimum residual spread (log10 units) so an address with near-identical residuals cannot divide by ~0

evaluation._explainabilityOrder: plan §11.4: the tie-break when two methods' mean injection recall is within tieMarginPoints

_explorerMethod: the DS1 method the Explorer and predict.py use (plan §11.4): the robust-z baseline, as models/selection.json recommends; recorded 23 Oct by Cao Tri Tran with the team's delegation

txgpt._relativeMinScale: floor on the spread (nats) of an address's earlier surprisals, as minScale does for the baseline (CR-05)

reasons.GAP: the timing was unusual for this address
reasons.DIR: the direction was unusual for this address
reasons.AMT: the amount was unusual for this address
reasons.NIN: the transaction's shape (its inputs) was unusual for this address
reasons.NOUT: the transaction's shape (its outputs) was unusual for this address
reasons.FEE: the fee rate was unusual for this address

injection._about: Synthetic plants (plan §6.4, A1 §2.3.2). Tuning seeds never score the reported results.

elliptic._about: DS3 processing (plan §6.3): Weber et al. (2019) temporal split; tuning stays inside the training steps.

bitcoinheist._about: DS4 processing (plan §6.4). Features exclude address, year and day; year only defines splits.
bitcoinheist._log1pIfSkewAbove: log(1+x) for weight, count, looped and neighbors when their skewness exceeds this (plan: 'if the analysis confirms heavy tails'); income is always log10

classification._about: Model grids for DS3 and DS4 (plan §9.4). Random searches draw nIter configurations with the seed.
classification._rfMaxSamples: rows drawn for each tree's bootstrap; bounds memory and time on DS4 (the plan's grid grows full-depth trees on ~400k rows, several GB for 600 trees)

labelCheck._about: Unsupervised methods scored against DS3/DS4 labels (plan §9.4, §10.2). Every method fits on the same seeded sample of training rows; LOF and DBSCAN keep them in memory.

reviewer._about: The blind reviewer check (plan §11.1): top flagged plus random unflagged evaluation rows of the selected method, shuffled.

ds7._about: Explanation pairs for both Explorer Assistants (plan §6.7). DS1 transactions are what the Explorer shows, so DS1 addresses give more pairs each; DS2 fills the rest.
